# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/ansible-builder
# args: 
usage: ansible-builder [-h] [--version] {create,build,introspect} ...

Tooling to help build container images for running Ansible content. Get
started by looking at the help text for one of the subcommands.

positional arguments:
  {create,build,introspect}
                        The command to invoke.
    create              Creates a build context, which can be used by podman
                        to build an image.
    build               Builds a container image.
    introspect          Introspects collections in folder.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             Print ansible-builder version and exit.
